To extend the useful life period of the medicinal product, the manufacturer will have to submit three natural stability studies under experimental conditions of moisture and temperature, corresponding to Climate Zone IV (IHL Guide) or Pharmacopoeia of the United States of America, with duration equal to the proposed useful lifetime. To extend the useful life period of the medicinal product, the manufacturer will have to submit three stability studies under experimental conditions of moisture and temperature, corresponding to Climate Zone IV (IHL Guide) or Pharmacopoeia of the United States of America, with duration equal to the proposed useful lifetime. Accelerated studies performed according to the conditions and requirements established for area IV are accepted by an ICH guide as applicable.
translation_review.checked_translation: For medicines from countries where stability studies were not conducted for Climatic Zone IV conditions (under the ICH stability-study classification), the shelf life of the medicine registered by homologation shall be six (6) months. To extend the shelf life, the manufacturer must submit three natural stability studies under experimental humidity and temperature conditions corresponding to Climatic Zone IV (ICH Guide) or the United States Pharmacopoeia, lasting as long as the proposed shelf life. To extend the shelf life, the manufacturer must submit three stability studies under experimental humidity and temperature conditions corresponding to Climatic Zone IV (ICH Guide) or the United States Pharmacopoeia, lasting as long as the proposed shelf life. Accelerated studies conducted under the conditions and requirements established for Zone IV by an ICH guide are accepted where applicable.
